# 0. Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center"
)

options(scipen = 999)

# Helper functions

clean_blank_to_na <- function(x) {
  x_char <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x_char[x_char == ""] <- NA
  x_char
}

coef_to_percent <- function(beta) {
  100 * (exp(beta) - 1)
}

model_metrics <- function(model, model_name) {
  data.frame(
    Model = model_name,
    N = nobs(model),
    Num_Coefficients = length(coef(model)),
    Residual_SE = round(summary(model)$sigma, 4),
    R2 = round(summary(model)$r.squared, 4),
    Adjusted_R2 = round(summary(model)$adj.r.squared, 4),
    AIC = round(AIC(model), 2),
    BIC = round(BIC(model), 2),
    RSS = round(sum(resid(model)^2), 2),
    row.names = NULL
  )
}

compare_models <- function(model_list) {
  out <- do.call(
    rbind,
    Map(model_metrics, model_list, names(model_list))
  )
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out
}

tidy_coef_table <- function(model) {
  coef_sum <- summary(model)$coefficients
  conf_int <- confint(model)

  data.frame(
    Predictor = rownames(coef_sum),
    Estimate = coef_sum[, "Estimate"],
    Std_Error = coef_sum[, "Std. Error"],
    CI_Lower = conf_int[, 1],
    CI_Upper = conf_int[, 2],
    P_value = coef_sum[, "Pr(>|t|)"],
    row.names = NULL
  )
}

influence_summary_table <- function(model) {
  n <- nobs(model)
  k <- length(coef(model))

  standardized_residuals <- rstandard(model)
  leverage_values <- hatvalues(model)
  cooks_values <- cooks.distance(model)

  data.frame(
    Diagnostic = c(
      "|standardized residual| > 4",
      "Leverage > 2k/n",
      "Cook's distance > 4/n",
      "Cook's distance > 1"
    ),
    Cutoff = c(
      4,
      2 * k / n,
      4 / n,
      1
    ),
    Count = c(
      sum(abs(standardized_residuals) > 4),
      sum(leverage_values > 2 * k / n),
      sum(cooks_values > 4 / n),
      sum(cooks_values > 1)
    ),
    row.names = NULL
  )
}

kfold_cv_lm <- function(formula, data, k = 10, seed = 302) {
  set.seed(seed)

  n <- nrow(data)
  fold_id <- sample(rep(seq_len(k), length.out = n))

  fold_results <- lapply(seq_len(k), function(j) {
    train_data <- data[fold_id != j, ]
    test_data <- data[fold_id == j, ]

    fit_j <- lm(formula, data = train_data)
    pred_j <- predict(fit_j, newdata = test_data)

    data.frame(
      Fold = j,
      MSE = mean((test_data$log_price - pred_j)^2),
      RMSE = sqrt(mean((test_data$log_price - pred_j)^2)),
      MAE = mean(abs(test_data$log_price - pred_j))
    )
  })

  fold_results <- do.call(rbind, fold_results)

  data.frame(
    CV_MSE = mean(fold_results$MSE),
    CV_RMSE = mean(fold_results$RMSE),
    CV_MAE = mean(fold_results$MAE),
    SD_RMSE = sd(fold_results$RMSE),
    row.names = NULL
  )
}
```

# 1. Load and Clean Data

```{r data-cleaning, include=FALSE}
df <- read.csv("original_data.csv")

# Select variables used in the analysis

airbnb <- df[, c(
  "price",
  "accommodates",
  "bedrooms",
  "bathrooms",
  "room_type",
  "neighbourhood_cleansed",
  "minimum_nights",
  "availability_365",
  "number_of_reviews",
  "reviews_per_month",
  "review_scores_rating",
  "review_scores_location",
  "review_scores_cleanliness",
  "host_is_superhost",
  "host_identity_verified",
  "instant_bookable",
  "calculated_host_listings_count"
)]

# Clean price and create log price

airbnb$price_num <- as.numeric(gsub("[$,]", "", airbnb$price))
airbnb$log_price <- log(airbnb$price_num)

airbnb <- airbnb[!is.na(airbnb$price_num), ]
airbnb <- airbnb[airbnb$price_num > 0, ]

# Remove extreme bedroom and bathroom values

airbnb <- airbnb[is.na(airbnb$bedrooms) | airbnb$bedrooms <= 10, ]
airbnb <- airbnb[is.na(airbnb$bathrooms) | airbnb$bathrooms <= 10, ]

# Restrict the nightly prices

airbnb <- airbnb[airbnb$price_num >= 50 & airbnb$price_num <= 3000, ]

# Clean categorical variables

categorical_vars <- c(
  "host_is_superhost",
  "host_identity_verified",
  "instant_bookable",
  "room_type",
  "neighbourhood_cleansed"
)

for (v in categorical_vars) {
  airbnb[[v]] <- clean_blank_to_na(airbnb[[v]])
  airbnb[[v]] <- as.factor(airbnb[[v]])
}

airbnb$host_is_superhost <- factor(
  airbnb$host_is_superhost,
  levels = c("f", "t")
)

airbnb$host_identity_verified <- factor(
  airbnb$host_identity_verified,
  levels = c("f", "t")
)

airbnb$instant_bookable <- factor(
  airbnb$instant_bookable,
  levels = c("f", "t")
)

airbnb$room_type <- relevel(
  airbnb$room_type,
  ref = "Entire home/apt"
)

# Preliminary model dataset

model_data <- airbnb[, c(
  "log_price",
  "price_num",
  "accommodates",
  "bedrooms",
  "bathrooms",
  "minimum_nights",
  "review_scores_rating",
  "host_is_superhost",
  "room_type",
  "neighbourhood_cleansed"
)]

model_data <- na.omit(model_data)
model_data$log_minimum_nights <- log(model_data$minimum_nights)

# Extended dataset for model selection

model_vars_extended <- c(
  "log_price",
  "price_num",
  "accommodates",
  "bedrooms",
  "bathrooms",
  "minimum_nights",
  "availability_365",
  "number_of_reviews",
  "reviews_per_month",
  "review_scores_rating",
  "review_scores_location",
  "review_scores_cleanliness",
  "host_is_superhost",
  "host_identity_verified",
  "instant_bookable",
  "calculated_host_listings_count",
  "room_type",
  "neighbourhood_cleansed"
)

model_data_extended <- airbnb[, model_vars_extended]

for (v in categorical_vars) {
  model_data_extended[[v]] <- clean_blank_to_na(model_data_extended[[v]])
}

model_data_extended <- na.omit(model_data_extended)

model_data_extended$log_number_of_reviews <- log(model_data_extended$number_of_reviews + 1)
model_data_extended$log_reviews_per_month <- log(model_data_extended$reviews_per_month + 1)
model_data_extended$log_host_listings <- log(model_data_extended$calculated_host_listings_count + 1)
model_data_extended$log_minimum_nights <- log(model_data_extended$minimum_nights)

for (v in categorical_vars) {
  model_data_extended[[v]] <- droplevels(as.factor(model_data_extended[[v]]))
}
```

# 3. Preliminary Model

```{r preliminary-model, include=FALSE}
formula_preliminary_original <- log_price ~ accommodates + bedrooms + bathrooms +
  minimum_nights + review_scores_rating +
  host_is_superhost + room_type + neighbourhood_cleansed

fit_preliminary_original <- lm(
  formula_preliminary_original,
  data = model_data
)

preliminary_metrics <- model_metrics(
  fit_preliminary_original,
  "Preliminary model"
)

preliminary_fitted <- fitted(fit_preliminary_original)
preliminary_residuals <- resid(fit_preliminary_original)
preliminary_standardized_residuals <- rstandard(fit_preliminary_original)
```

# 4. Model Selection

```{r model-selection, include=FALSE}
# Define model formulas

formula_prelim <- log_price ~ accommodates + bedrooms + bathrooms +
  minimum_nights + review_scores_rating +
  host_is_superhost + room_type + neighbourhood_cleansed

formula_log_min <- log_price ~ accommodates + bedrooms + bathrooms +
  log_minimum_nights + review_scores_rating +
  host_is_superhost + room_type + neighbourhood_cleansed

formula_no_min <- log_price ~ accommodates + bedrooms + bathrooms +
  review_scores_rating +
  host_is_superhost + room_type + neighbourhood_cleansed

formula_interaction <- log_price ~ accommodates * room_type +
  bedrooms + bathrooms +
  minimum_nights + review_scores_rating +
  host_is_superhost + neighbourhood_cleansed

formula_extended <- log_price ~ accommodates * room_type +
  bedrooms + bathrooms +
  minimum_nights +
  availability_365 +
  log_number_of_reviews +
  log_reviews_per_month +
  review_scores_rating +
  review_scores_location +
  review_scores_cleanliness +
  host_is_superhost +
  host_identity_verified +
  instant_bookable +
  log_host_listings +
  neighbourhood_cleansed

# Fit candidate models

fit_prelim_ext <- lm(formula_prelim, data = model_data_extended)
fit_log_min_ext <- lm(formula_log_min, data = model_data_extended)
fit_no_min_ext <- lm(formula_no_min, data = model_data_extended)
fit_interaction_ext <- lm(formula_interaction, data = model_data_extended)
fit_extended <- lm(formula_extended, data = model_data_extended)

# Transformation and interaction

transformation_models <- list(
  "Raw minimum nights" = fit_prelim_ext,
  "Log minimum nights" = fit_log_min_ext,
  "No minimum nights" = fit_no_min_ext
)

transformation_comparison <- compare_models(transformation_models)

candidate_models <- list(
  "Preliminary model" = fit_prelim_ext,
  "Interaction model" = fit_interaction_ext,
  "Full extended model" = fit_extended
)

candidate_model_comparison <- compare_models(candidate_models)

test_minimum_nights <- anova(fit_no_min_ext, fit_prelim_ext)
test_interaction <- anova(fit_prelim_ext, fit_interaction_ext)
test_extended_predictors <- anova(fit_interaction_ext, fit_extended)

# Multicollinearity

if (requireNamespace("car", quietly = TRUE)) {
  vif_values <- car::vif(fit_extended)

  if (is.matrix(vif_values)) {
    vif_table <- data.frame(
      Predictor = rownames(vif_values),
      GVIF = vif_values[, "GVIF"],
      Df = vif_values[, "Df"],
      Adjusted_GVIF = vif_values[, "GVIF^(1/(2*Df))"],
      row.names = NULL
    )
  } else {
    vif_table <- data.frame(
      Predictor = names(vif_values),
      VIF = as.numeric(vif_values),
      row.names = NULL
    )
  }
} else {
  vif_table <- data.frame(
    Message = "Package 'car' is not installed"
  )
}

# Influence and sensitivity analysis

influence_counts_extended <- influence_summary_table(fit_extended)

standardized_residuals_ext <- rstandard(fit_extended)
leverage_ext <- hatvalues(fit_extended)
cooks_ext <- cooks.distance(fit_extended)

influence_details <- data.frame(
  row_id = seq_len(nrow(model_data_extended)),
  price_num = model_data_extended$price_num,
  log_price = model_data_extended$log_price,
  accommodates = model_data_extended$accommodates,
  bedrooms = model_data_extended$bedrooms,
  bathrooms = model_data_extended$bathrooms,
  minimum_nights = model_data_extended$minimum_nights,
  room_type = model_data_extended$room_type,
  neighbourhood_cleansed = model_data_extended$neighbourhood_cleansed,
  standardized_residual = standardized_residuals_ext,
  leverage = leverage_ext,
  cooks_distance = cooks_ext
)

top_influential <- head(
  influence_details[order(-influence_details$cooks_distance), ],
  10
)

model_data_no_high_cook <- model_data_extended[cooks_ext <= 0.01, ]

fit_extended_no_high_cook <- lm(
  formula_extended,
  data = model_data_no_high_cook
)

sensitivity_comparison <- compare_models(
  list(
    "Full extended model" = fit_extended,
    "Without Cook > 0.01" = fit_extended_no_high_cook
  )
)

main_terms <- c(
  "accommodates",
  "bedrooms",
  "bathrooms",
  "minimum_nights",
  "log_number_of_reviews",
  "log_reviews_per_month",
  "review_scores_location",
  "review_scores_cleanliness",
  "host_is_superhostt",
  "host_identity_verifiedt"
)

main_terms <- main_terms[main_terms %in% names(coef(fit_extended))]

coef_sensitivity <- data.frame(
  Term = main_terms,
  Full_Model = coef(fit_extended)[main_terms],
  Sensitivity_Model = coef(fit_extended_no_high_cook)[main_terms],
  row.names = NULL
)

coef_sensitivity$Difference <- coef_sensitivity$Sensitivity_Model -
  coef_sensitivity$Full_Model

# AIC/BIC stepwise selection

fit_step_aic <- step(
  fit_extended,
  direction = "both",
  trace = FALSE
)

fit_step_bic <- step(
  fit_extended,
  direction = "both",
  k = log(nobs(fit_extended)),
  trace = FALSE
)

stepwise_models <- list(
  "Preliminary model" = fit_prelim_ext,
  "Interaction model" = fit_interaction_ext,
  "Full extended model" = fit_extended,
  "AIC stepwise model" = fit_step_aic,
  "BIC stepwise detailed model" = fit_step_bic
)

stepwise_comparison <- compare_models(stepwise_models)

# Final selected model

final_fit <- fit_step_bic

final_model_metrics <- model_metrics(
  final_fit,
  "Final selected BIC detailed model"
)

coef_table <- tidy_coef_table(final_fit)
```

# 5. Model Validation

```{r model-validation, include=FALSE}
validation_formulas <- list(
  "Preliminary model" = formula(fit_prelim_ext),
  "Interaction model" = formula(fit_interaction_ext),
  "Full extended model" = formula(fit_extended),
  "Final BIC detailed model" = formula(final_fit)
)

cv_results <- do.call(
  rbind,
  Map(
    function(model_formula, model_name) {
      out <- kfold_cv_lm(
        formula = model_formula,
        data = model_data_extended,
        k = 10,
        seed = 302
      )

      out$Model <- model_name
      out
    },
    validation_formulas,
    names(validation_formulas)
  )
)

cv_results <- cv_results[, c(
  "Model",
  "CV_MSE",
  "CV_RMSE",
  "CV_MAE",
  "SD_RMSE"
)]

cv_results[, -1] <- round(cv_results[, -1], 4)
```

```{r ml-benchmarks, include=FALSE}

# Supplementary predictive benchmark only.
# Requires optional packages: FNN, ranger, xgboost.
# If a package is not installed, the corresponding method is skipped.
# This chunk may take several minutes to run.

set.seed(302)

x_matrix <- model.matrix(formula(final_fit), data = model_data_extended)[, -1]
y <- model_data_extended$log_price
x_scaled <- scale(x_matrix)

n <- nrow(model_data_extended)
k_folds <- 10
fold_id <- sample(rep(seq_len(k_folds), length.out = n))

linear_row <- cv_results[
  cv_results$Model == "Final BIC detailed model",
]

benchmark_results <- data.frame(
  Model = "Final BIC detailed linear model",
  CV_RMSE = linear_row$CV_RMSE,
  CV_MAE = linear_row$CV_MAE,
  SD_RMSE = linear_row$SD_RMSE
)

if (requireNamespace("FNN", quietly = TRUE)) {
  candidate_k <- c(5, 10, 25, 50, 100)

  knn_cv_results <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(candidate_k, function(k_value) {
      fold_results <- do.call(
        rbind,
        lapply(seq_len(k_folds), function(j) {
          train_index <- fold_id != j
          test_index <- fold_id == j

          knn_fit <- FNN::knn.reg(
            train = x_scaled[train_index, ],
            test = x_scaled[test_index, ],
            y = y[train_index],
            k = k_value
          )

          pred <- knn_fit$pred

          data.frame(
            RMSE = sqrt(mean((y[test_index] - pred)^2)),
            MAE = mean(abs(y[test_index] - pred))
          )
        })
      )

      data.frame(
        Model = paste0("KNN regression, k = ", k_value),
        CV_RMSE = mean(fold_results$RMSE),
        CV_MAE = mean(fold_results$MAE),
        SD_RMSE = sd(fold_results$RMSE)
      )
    })
  )

  best_knn <- knn_cv_results[
    which.min(knn_cv_results$CV_RMSE),
  ]

  benchmark_results <- rbind(
    benchmark_results,
    best_knn
  )
}

if (requireNamespace("ranger", quietly = TRUE)) {
  rf_formula <- log_price ~
    accommodates +
    bedrooms +
    bathrooms +
    minimum_nights +
    log_number_of_reviews +
    log_reviews_per_month +
    review_scores_location +
    review_scores_cleanliness +
    host_is_superhost +
    host_identity_verified +
    room_type +
    neighbourhood_cleansed

  rf_fold_results <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(seq_len(k_folds), function(j) {
      train_data <- model_data_extended[fold_id != j, ]
      test_data <- model_data_extended[fold_id == j, ]

      rf_fit <- ranger::ranger(
        formula = rf_formula,
        data = train_data,
        num.trees = 300,
        mtry = 4,
        min.node.size = 10,
        seed = 302
      )

      pred <- predict(rf_fit, data = test_data)$predictions

      data.frame(
        RMSE = sqrt(mean((test_data$log_price - pred)^2)),
        MAE = mean(abs(test_data$log_price - pred))
      )
    })
  )

  rf_cv_results <- data.frame(
    Model = "Random forest",
    CV_RMSE = mean(rf_fold_results$RMSE),
    CV_MAE = mean(rf_fold_results$MAE),
    SD_RMSE = sd(rf_fold_results$RMSE)
  )

  benchmark_results <- rbind(
    benchmark_results,
    rf_cv_results
  )
}

if (requireNamespace("xgboost", quietly = TRUE)) {
  xgb_fold_results <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(seq_len(k_folds), function(j) {
      train_index <- fold_id != j
      test_index <- fold_id == j

      dtrain <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(
        data = x_matrix[train_index, ],
        label = y[train_index]
      )

      dtest <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(
        data = x_matrix[test_index, ],
        label = y[test_index]
      )

      xgb_fit <- xgboost::xgb.train(
        params = list(
          objective = "reg:squarederror",
          eval_metric = "rmse",
          max_depth = 3,
          eta = 0.05,
          subsample = 0.8,
          colsample_bytree = 0.8,
          nthread = 2
        ),
        data = dtrain,
        nrounds = 150,
        verbose = 0
      )

      pred <- predict(xgb_fit, dtest)

      data.frame(
        RMSE = sqrt(mean((y[test_index] - pred)^2)),
        MAE = mean(abs(y[test_index] - pred))
      )
    })
  )

  xgb_cv_results <- data.frame(
    Model = "Gradient boosting",
    CV_RMSE = mean(xgb_fold_results$RMSE),
    CV_MAE = mean(xgb_fold_results$MAE),
    SD_RMSE = sd(xgb_fold_results$RMSE)
  )

  benchmark_results <- rbind(
    benchmark_results,
    xgb_cv_results
  )
}

benchmark_results$CV_RMSE <- round(benchmark_results$CV_RMSE, 4)
benchmark_results$CV_MAE <- round(benchmark_results$CV_MAE, 4)
benchmark_results$SD_RMSE <- round(benchmark_results$SD_RMSE, 4)
```

# 6. Final Report Tables and Figures

```{r selected-coefficient-table, include=FALSE}
selected_terms <- c(
  "accommodates",
  "bedrooms",
  "bathrooms",
  "minimum_nights",
  "log_number_of_reviews",
  "log_reviews_per_month",
  "review_scores_location",
  "review_scores_cleanliness",
  "host_is_superhostt",
  "host_identity_verifiedt"
)

selected_coef_table <- coef_table[
  coef_table$Predictor %in% selected_terms,
]

selected_coef_table <- selected_coef_table[
  match(selected_terms, selected_coef_table$Predictor),
]

selected_coef_table$Predictor <- c(
  "Accommodates",
  "Bedrooms",
  "Bathrooms",
  "Minimum nights",
  "Log number of reviews",
  "Log reviews per month",
  "Review score for location",
  "Review score for cleanliness",
  "Superhost",
  "Host identity verified"
)

selected_coef_table$Approx_Price_Change <- round(
  coef_to_percent(selected_coef_table$Estimate),
  1
)

selected_coef_table$Estimate <- round(selected_coef_table$Estimate, 4)
selected_coef_table$Std_Error <- round(selected_coef_table$Std_Error, 4)
selected_coef_table$CI_Lower <- round(selected_coef_table$CI_Lower, 4)
selected_coef_table$CI_Upper <- round(selected_coef_table$CI_Upper, 4)
selected_coef_table$P_value <- signif(selected_coef_table$P_value, 3)

selected_coef_table <- selected_coef_table[, c(
  "Predictor",
  "Estimate",
  "Std_Error",
  "CI_Lower",
  "CI_Upper",
  "P_value",
  "Approx_Price_Change"
)]
```

```{r capacity-effects-table, include=FALSE}
capacity_effects <- data.frame(
  Room_Type = c(
    "Entire home/apt",
    "Hotel room",
    "Private room",
    "Shared room"
  ),
  Log_Effect = c(
    coef(final_fit)["accommodates"],
    coef(final_fit)["accommodates"] +
      coef(final_fit)["accommodates:room_typeHotel room"],
    coef(final_fit)["accommodates"] +
      coef(final_fit)["accommodates:room_typePrivate room"],
    coef(final_fit)["accommodates"] +
      coef(final_fit)["accommodates:room_typeShared room"]
  ),
  row.names = NULL
)

capacity_effects$Approx_Price_Change <- round(
  coef_to_percent(capacity_effects$Log_Effect),
  1
)

capacity_effects$Log_Effect <- round(capacity_effects$Log_Effect, 4)
```

```{r final-diagnostic-panel, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2),
    mar = c(4.2, 4.2, 3, 1),
    oma = c(0, 0, 2, 0))

plot(
  fitted(final_fit),
  resid(final_fit),
  main = "Residuals vs Fitted",
  xlab = "Fitted Values",
  ylab = "Residuals",
  pch = 16,
  cex = 0.35
)
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

plot(
  fitted(final_fit),
  rstandard(final_fit),
  main = "Standardized Residuals vs Fitted",
  xlab = "Fitted Values",
  ylab = "Standardized Residuals",
  pch = 16,
  cex = 0.35
)
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

hist(
  rstandard(final_fit),
  main = "Histogram of Standardized Residuals",
  xlab = "Standardized Residuals",
  breaks = 40
)

qqnorm(
  rstandard(final_fit),
  main = "Normal Q-Q Plot",
  pch = 16,
  cex = 0.35
)
qqline(rstandard(final_fit), lty = 2)

mtext(
  "Residual Diagnostic Plots for Final Model",
  outer = TRUE,
  cex = 1.2,
  font = 2
)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
